body:
## Summary

Two silent-failure paths in `src/bos/worker.ts` — both leave the chat panel hanging because `sendSlashRequest` has no timeout (src/chat/agent.ts:713).

### 1. Stale module-global `abortController` reused for slash dispatch (worker.ts:1197)

```ts
const matched = await handleSlashCommand(msg.text, abortController?.signal ?? new AbortController().signal, emit);
```
`handleCancel()` (worker.ts:594) aborts the module-global `abortController` and nothing resets it until the next `chat`/`paper` message. Every subsequent slash command then runs with an already-aborted signal:
- All `token` emits are dropped by the emit wrapper (worker.ts:234) — user gets an empty reply from `/goal`, `/search`, etc.
- If the command **throws**, the catch at worker.ts:477 suppresses `'error'` too (`if (!signal.aborted)`), and the command never emitted its own `'done'` → nothing reaches the panel → **permanent hang**.

**Repro:** send chat → click Cancel → run `/goal` (empty reply). Then make a command throw (e.g. delete the workspace and run `/init` → `fs.mkdirSync` throws) → neither done nor error → hang.

**Fix:** `abortController = new AbortController();` before the non-pubsub `handleSlashCommand` call (mirroring the `chat` handler), and emit `'error'` unconditionally in the catch (the wrapper already passes done/error through when aborted).

### 2. `drainMsgQueue` swallows deps-init failures without emitting `'error'` (worker.ts:979-991)

```ts
} catch (err) { log.error({ err, msgType: item.type }, 'message processing error'); }
```
In the non-pubsub paths, `composeRoot(...)` sits **outside** the internal try/catch of both handlers (slash: composeRoot at :456, try starts at :474; chat: composeRoot at :1353, try starts at :1613). A `composeRoot` throw (bad workspaceRoot, brain start failure) propagates out of the enqueue run-fn and is swallowed here — no `error` reaches the panel, `await sendSlashRequest` never settles. The `init` case resets `depsInitPromise`/`deps` on failure (:1030-1035) but also emits nothing.

**Fix:** wrap each enqueue run-fn body in try/catch and `emit('error', errorPayload(err))` on failure (mirroring the pubsub handler's catch).
title: Worker slash dispatch: stale abortController after cancel drops all slash output; composeRoot/deps-init failures swallowed without 'error' emit
